children.name: Website & Landing Page Templates
children.delivery: Project ZIP: HTML/CSS/JS, React/Next.js source, or supported CMS theme files
children.preview: Actual desktop and mobile screenshots; live site preview if available
children.proof: Working page/navigation demo; show mobile layout and functioning features
children.software: Required browser, framework or CMS version, hosting, packages and paid integrations
children.guide: Unzip or install theme; edit text and images; configure dependencies; run and deploy
children.package: Project files, included assets, README, setup/deployment steps, sample config if needed, licence

children.name: UI Kits & Design Files
children.delivery: Editable Figma copy link or supported Sketch/AI/SVG files; ZIP if several files
children.preview: Real screens, components, color styles, variations and example layouts
children.proof: Demonstrate editing components, replacing assets and exporting; video optional
children.software: Compatible editor and version; fonts, plugins or paid assets if required
children.guide: Open/duplicate file; update colors, fonts and components; export for use
children.package: Editable design files or verified copy link, included assets, brief usage notes, licence

children.name: Downloadable Workflow Files

formats.name: n8n
formats.note: Upload an n8n workflow export and remove credentials.

children.delivery: Import file supported by each platform; e.g. n8n .json or Make blueprint .json
children.preview: Real workflow diagram, actions used and sample input/output
children.proof: Successful run using dummy data; show actual result, not a mockup
children.software: Exact automation platform/version, required apps, API accounts, paid plans and plugins
children.guide: Import file; connect your own accounts; replace placeholders; set trigger; test run
children.package: Workflow import file, setup steps, list of integrations, dummy sample input if needed, troubleshooting notes, licence

children.name: Shared Automation Templates
children.delivery: Verified template/duplicate link; detailed rebuild instructions if no import is supported
children.preview: Screenshots of trigger, actions, mappings and end result
children.proof: Demonstrate copied or recreated automation working with sample data

children.package: Working template link or reproducible step-by-step document, example inputs/outputs, licence

children.name: Automation Scripts
children.delivery: ZIP with .py, .js, .gs or other actual script files; config and dependency lists

children.proof: Record script running successfully with safe example data

children.guide: Install requirements; enter own credentials; configure inputs; run or schedule script
children.package: Runnable source, requirements, safe example config, README, sample input/output if relevant, licence

children.name: Editable Presentation Templates

children.proof: Show a sample slide being edited; animations only if advertised

children.guide: Open/duplicate; edit text/images/charts; replace fonts; export
children.package: Editable slides, PDF preview, font/asset list, short editing instructions, licence

children.name: Professional Document Templates

children.preview: Blank and filled example pages; show layout clearly
